Name: Minecart Station - placeable building
Author: semper1dem
Description:
[center][/center][center][/center][left][center][/center]Adds new building - Minecart Station - which allows to travel to other Minecart locations and back
[list]
[*]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Stations appear as destinations in the default minecart network
[*]Right-click the station (on the minecart tiles) to open the destination menu
[*]Requires minecarts to be unlocked
[*]Configurable via content.json
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26873?tab=bugs]Multiple Farms For Multiplayer[/url] (and is basically reason why I made it)
[*]SHOULD also work with ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url]
[/list][/left]

Manifest.Name: Minecart Station
Manifest.Description: Adds Minecart Station that connects the location to the minecart network
